content: Gitea PR review API is materially less capable than GitHub: no webhook for PR code comments (issue 26023), reviews can be created and deleted but not updated (32898), no API to post line-level diff comments (36300, web UI only, CSRF/session bound), no API to fetch conversation-page comments (17683), no reply-to-review-comment endpoint. GitLab uses MRs with discussions/notes, iid vs id numbering, approvals as a separate resource, and draft (was WIP) status. GitHub secondary rate limits specifically penalise rapid content creation (comments, PRs), return 403 with abuse/secondary wording, and require multi-minute backoff (commonly 180s doubling).
